members.name: items
members.doc: The options as data: strings, or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, and `disabled`. Children take precedence: when both are supplied, the items are not rendered.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every item and stops the action callbacks. An item's own `disabled={false}` cannot re-enable it under a disabled list.

members.name: shouldCloseOnSelect
members.doc: Whether choosing an item closes the menu, in place of the root's setting. A Menu.Item can still set its own.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called when the user activates an item. A list built from `items` passes the item record; one built from children passes the identity fields `id`, `key`, and `value`. It is not called for a disabled item or while the list is disabled.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Called with the same item as `onAction`, right after it.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the menu is open, when the caller controls it. A disabled menu is closed whatever this says.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the menu starts open, when it controls itself.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called with the next open state when the menu opens or closes. It is not called for a request to open a disabled menu.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the trigger and every item. A child's own `disabled={false}` cannot re-enable them under a disabled root.

members.name: shouldCloseOnSelect
members.doc: Whether choosing an item closes the menu. A Menu.List or Menu.Item can set its own, which wins over this.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called when the user activates an item in any list of the menu, after the item's own `onAction` and the list's callbacks. A list built from `items` passes the item record; one built from children passes the identity fields `id`, `key`, and `value`. It is not called for a disabled item or while the menu is disabled.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Called with the same item as `onAction`, right after it.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the trigger: it can be neither focused nor activated. A disabled menu disables it whatever this says.

members.name: onActivate
members.doc: Called when the user activates the trigger, before the menu opens or closes. It is not called while the trigger is disabled.

members.name: placement
members.doc: Where the popup opens against its trigger or anchorRef. start and end follow the locale direction. Without one, a top-level popup opens at `bottom-start`, and a popup inside a Menu.Submenu opens beside its item at `end-top`.

members.name: offset
members.doc: The distance in pixels between the popup and its trigger, along the placement's side. Must be finite.

members.name: crossOffset
members.doc: The shift in pixels along the side the popup is placed against. Must be finite.

members.name: shouldFlip
members.doc: Whether the popup moves to the opposite side when the placed side has no room.

members.name: containerPadding
members.doc: The least distance in pixels between the popup and the edge of the viewport. Must be finite and not negative.

members.name: modal
members.doc: Whether the rest of the page is made inaccessible while the popup is open. When false, outside content stays accessible.
